description: Curated plugin references for the thin Craft kernel. Craft itself does not implement these; it lists external plugins for users to install. Host resolution follows catalog/host-priority.json.

bundled.name: craft-context
bundled.description: Default Craft context entry: Knowledge, Memory, Experience, Codebase with bounded receipts.

bundled.name: craft-datasec
bundled.description: Default local text redaction hook; no Context or MCP dependency.

craft_optional_source_plugins.name: craft-file-dir-desc
craft_optional_source_plugins.description: Directory semantic descriptions from craft-capability source; source-built plugin, not published in this marketplace package yet.

industry.name: github
industry.description: GitHub repositories, issues and pull requests

custom_import.description: Users may import any external plugin manifest. Resolution order is fixed by host-priority.json; an imported plugin that supports multiple Hosts is installed once, using the first available Host.
